tools.name: search_assessments
tools.description: Search AssessAll's public catalogue of online assessments by skill, role, purpose or keyword (e.g. 'numerical reasoning', 'first-time manager', 'spoken English for BPO', 'POSH committee'). Returns titles, links, categories and one-time prices in INR and USD.

tools.name: get_assessment
tools.description: Full description, link, category and one-time INR and USD price for one AssessAll assessment, by the slug returned from search_assessments.

tools.name: list_practice_tests
tools.description: Free practice tests on assessall.com that need no account and score instantly in the browser, with the paid full-length assessment each one rehearses.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search AssessAll's guides on assessment practice: validity, reliability, cut scores, CEFR levels, 360 feedback, training needs analysis, hiring at scale and similar. Returns titles, one-line summaries and links.
